def modify_features(X, history):
    F = pd.DataFrame(index=X.index)
    # Mean customer age
    customer_age_mean = history.groupby('customer_id')['customer_age'].mean().to_frame('mean_customer_age')
    F = pd.merge(F, customer_age_mean, left_index=True, right_index=True, validate='many_to_one', how='left')
    
    # Count past purchases of same product type per customer
    customer_product_type_purchases = history.groupby(['customer_id', 'product_type_no'])['days_ago'].count().to_frame('count_product_type_purchases')
    F = pd.merge(F, customer_product_type_purchases, left_index=True, right_index=False, validate='many_to_one', how='left', suffixes=('', '_product_type'))
    
    # Count transactions in the last 7 days per product type
    recent_purchases = history[(history['days_ago'] <= 7)]
    product_type_recent_purchases = recent_purchases.groupby('product_type_no')['days_ago'].count().to_frame('count_recent_purchases_product_type')
    F = pd.merge(F, product_type_recent_purchases, left_index=True, right_index=False, validate='many_to_one', how='left', suffixes=('', '_recent_product_type'))
    
    # Count past purchases per product type
    product_type_purchases = history.groupby('product_type_no')['days_ago'].count().to_frame('total_purchases_product_type')
    F = pd.merge(F, product_type_purchases, left_index=True, right_index=False, validate='many_to_one', how='left', suffixes=('', '_product_type'))
    
    # Count past purchases in the same department per customer
    customer_department_purchases = history.groupby(['customer_id', 'department_no'])['days_ago'].count().to_frame('count_department_purchases')
    F = pd.merge(F, customer_department_purchases, left_index=True, right_index=False, validate='many_to_one', how='left', suffixes=('', '_department'))
    
    return F.iloc[:, :len(X.columns)]
